About

I’m Hamad Muhammad Salim, a senior product designer with ten years across fintech, ride-hailing, commerce and AI.

Story

I’ve worked at both ends of the scale. At Careem, I rebuilt how new users start on a super app used across the Middle East and South Asia, alongside a 40-person design team and five product squads. At Articos, I was the only designer on an AI research platform going from zero to one, and owned everything from customer calls to the frontend code.

Before that, I built and led design teams. At Savyour I set up the design practice, built BURAQ, a design system of more than 200 components, and managed a team of five designers. At Qureos I was the first designer, and the Product-Based Hiring module I designed reached EBITDA positivity within 20 days of launch.

The thread through all of it is simple: give people something before you ask them for anything.

In the field

Most of the people I have designed for do not work at a desk. At Retailo, design, product and engineering took turns visiting shopkeepers across Karachi, as far out as Orangi Town. One of them asked me whether the app was only for educated people. That question is why the catalogue went pictorial, and why sign-in came in Urdu and Arabic.

Outside the day job, I have trained designers at meetups across Pakistan and run bootcamps that introduce design as a career to young people from underprivileged communities.

How I work

I take the whole team to the people using the product.

  • Retailo, 2020Design, product and engineering took turns shadowing shopkeepers across Karachi.
  • Careem, 2023Interviews in Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and the UAE came before any screens.
  • Articos, 2026We spoke to customers almost every week, and one in five of them went on to buy.

I test before I am sure.

  • Retailo, 2020Paper wireframes went to nearby shops the day we drew them, then through 15 sessions at the monthly retailers’ convention.
  • Savyour, 2021When the pandemic kept us apart, we tested prototypes remotely with more than 50 people.
  • Disrupt, 2025MVP-in-a-day workshops, and production-ready MVPs in front of customers within days.

I design for low trust and low literacy.

  • Retailo, 2020A pictorial catalogue, sign-in in Urdu and Arabic, and support over WhatsApp, where retailers already were.
  • Savyour, 2021A wallet that shows monthly and lifetime savings, in a market where cashless adoption was under 2%.
  • Careem, 2023Codes over WhatsApp or SMS, a PIN for when SIM cards get recycled, and a switch for tourists.

I build the system other people build on.

  • Savyour, 2021BURAQ, a design system of more than 200 components.
  • Qureos, 2022The company’s first design system, as its first designer.
  • Articos, 2026A design almanac generated from production tokens, with most of the frontend shipped as my own pull requests.

I grow the people around me.

  • Savyour, 2021Hired and managed a team of five designers.
  • Careem, 2023Mentored designers across a 40-person design team.
  • Disrupt, 2025Set up the design function, hired and onboarded, then handed it to a Head of Design.
